crossRefs.note: He gave them their request, but sent leanness into their soul.
but a whole month, until it comes out at your nostrils, and it is loathsome to you; because you have rejected Yahweh…

translations.web: So they ate, and were well filled. He gave them their own desire.
translations.bsb: So they ate and were well filled, for He gave them what they craved.
translations.kjv: So they did eat, and were well filled: for he gave them their own desire;
translations.asv: So they did eat, and were well filled; And he gave them their own desire.
